newsitem.title: USA: Vacation Break to issue 8.7 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Vacation Break to issue 8.7 mln shrs.

text.p: Vacation Break U.S.A. said Thursday it will acquire the premium resorts and vacation interval ownership projects owned by Jim Lambert and Berkley Group but will not acquire the marketing and sales operations of the Berkley Group.
Instead, Vacation Break said it will sign an exclusive long-term marketing, sales and administrative services agreement with Berkley Group for the South Florida and Williamsburg, Va., markets.
The company said Lambert will resign as chief executive of Berkley Group and will become the chief executive of Vacation Break.

In connection with the acquisition, Vacation Break said it will issue a total of 8,700,000 shares of common stock, most of which will be held by Lambert and members of his family, with 1,000,000 shares held by Berkley Group, which will also maintain a board seat.
The company will also pay about $19,000,000 in cash to Lambert and the Berkley Group.
In addition, the company has agreed to purchase at Berkley's cost, estimated to be $7,000,000 at closing, land and development costs.
